title: Nectar Launches AI Growth Stack to Map 95% of Untagged Brand Mentions
summary:
Nectar has developed a platform that replaces more than five legacy marketing tools by automating creator outreach and creative research. The system identifies brand mentions across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, and Reddit by analyzing video frames, voiceovers, and on-screen text, converting them into more than 300 attributes. This addresses a visibility gap that Nectar estimates accounts for 95% of all brand conversations that occur in untagged posts, which traditional social tracking tools often miss.

The company is backed by Anthropic's Anthology Fund and recently integrated its tools into Anthropic's connector directory via a Model Context Protocol (MCP) for the Claude AI assistant. Nectar has attributed $150M from social media activity to date and enables users to perform live data analysis, such as ranking over 1,200 posts by saves to inform social leads on performance.
